scope: Completed capture, primary, A1, transfer-capture, prediction, freeze, receipt, and runtime-package artifacts inventoried by path, size, and SHA-256 only.

capacity_snapshot.recommendation: An optional second backup of the completed P11 private-evaluation tree, P11 experiment records, and verified TRR-0012 actual-r2 package is capacity-feasible; obtain the normal backup authorization before copying.

publication_recommendation.minimal_bundle: Publish or archive the small contract, phase, exclusion-release, restore, selector, primary integrity/run, A1 qualification/cost, transfer-capture receipt, and external runtime descriptor files listed in the minimal categories. Refresh mutable coordination/result records after final scoring.
publication_recommendation.private_companion: Retain source-selection, capture manifests, transfer-selection, A1 prediction descriptors, transfer-analysis descriptors, and token-bearing metadata in task-local private custody; publish hashes only where required.
publication_recommendation.bulky_arrays: Keep capture observations, A1 traces/predictions, transfer-capture arrays, and runtime states/readout task-local with the recorded hashes. Do not copy them into a public bundle by this audit.
publication_recommendation.truth_payload: Keep transfer-analysis truth payloads excluded from the public bundle; this audit only records their file metadata and hashes.
